mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 81 degrees at Verona City Hall. The moon phase is a Waning Crescent.

The Military Ridge State Trail will close between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from September 14 through mid-November for bridge work, with detours available. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects on October 5, and the IRONMAN bike course will bring traffic delays through Verona on September 13.

Today is a busy day for events, including the downtown farmer's market, trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow, and live music continues at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee on September 11.
The Verona Police Department reported an arrest on Sunday, August 30, involving a school staff member accused of an inappropriate relationship with a student that occurred in 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
